beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects this move to competition among highly capable people seeking scarce recognized positions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its proposed response preserves ambition while changing what ambition is invited to build.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers gain a different unit of analysis for judging entrepreneurial opportunity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The decentralized brand proposal treats a name as a store of accumulated trust.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Independent operators could reuse that trust while remaining answerable to a recognizable common promise.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Standards, registries, contribution memory, shared assets, and dispute procedures make the promise credible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The steward must protect quality without silently becoming an unrestricted owner.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Fork and exit rights matter because the shared institution can also fail or become captured.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book presents this as an architecture to test, rather than a proven universal replacement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its distinctiveness lies in joining market participation with governance of the trust everyone uses.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The practical doctrine begins with repeated work that independent operators keep rebuilding.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Training, quality assurance, documentation, or customer trust can provide a specific starting point.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed shared name must make a narrow promise that customers can understand.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A limited group can then compare actual coordination costs with the isolated alternative.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book recognizes that some ventures still need concentrated authority or conventional private ownership.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its proposal earns attention where reusable institutional work outweighs the burden of common governance.
